tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Full-text search over SNN's published GTA VI answers (release date, platforms, price, editions, launch fixes...). Returns short answers with verification status and source citations. Follow up with get_answer for the full text.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Get one SNN answer by slug (from search_answers or list_latest): full markdown answer, short answer, verification status and numbered source citations.

tools.name: list_latest
tools.description: Newest SNN items: answers (with verification status) and published video segments, newest first.

tools.name: get_street_question
tools.description: The question SNN is currently asking viewers on the Street Desk, when it closes, and where to answer (the human-only form at /submit).

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: SNN's on-air team. All anchors are fictional AI-generated characters; each entry carries that disclosure.

tools.name: get_clip_credits
tools.description: Creator credits for community clips SNN has featured (creator handle, platform, original link). Filter by creator handle or clip URL.

tools.name: list_breaking
tools.description: Latest SNN Breaking launch-desk items (GTA VI unlock times, file size, pre-load, patches, early issues), newest first. Each has a status (confirmed / reported / unconfirmed), citations and a link to the full answer page. Free: up to 5 items.

tools.name: live_breaking
tools.description: [MCP Pass] The full SNN Breaking feed with bodies and citations, filterable by topic and pollable with a "since" timestamp so an agent can follow launch night live. Topics: unlock-time, file-size, preload, platforms, price, cloud, disc, issues.

tools.name: search_full_text
tools.description: [MCP Pass] Full-text search across every SNN answer and SNN Breaking item, returning the complete markdown body, status and numbered citations for each match (up to 50).

tools.name: submit_clip_tip
tools.description: Send the SNN newsroom a link to a GTA VI clip (X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Reddit, Kick, Streamable). Goes to a human review queue; nothing is published automatically and no personal data is needed. Say whether the user made the clip or found it. Strict limits: 5 per hour per network.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_clip_credits, list_breaking · Private data: list_breaking, live_breaking · Public sink: get_street_question, submit_clip_tip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_clip_credits, list_breaking · Private data: list_breaking, live_breaking · Public sink: get_street_question, submit_clip_tip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
